source.directorySummary: Shared support layer for file commands providing CLI option normalization, ignore filtering with git integration, workspace root resolution and path validation, Blossom/Nostr file transfer, unified diff generation, and file-path breadcrumb rendering.

cli-option-parsing.ts.sourceSummary: Provides stringOrNull, intOrNull, boolToOverride, and csvToArrayOrNull helpers that normalize raw CLI option values to trimmed strings, numbers, boolean overrides, or CSV arrays with null fallbacks.

ignore-filter.ts.sourceSummary: Implements IgnoreFilter that evaluates .git, hidden-file allowlist, compiled extra-ignore globs, forced-include prefix, and cached git check-ignore/ls-files checks via Bun.spawnSync to decide if a workspace entry should be ignored.

nostr-file.ts.sourceSummary: Implements Blossom auth, upload, and download against https://blossom-01.uid.ovh/ using kind 24242 events and builds naddr identifiers for FILE_KIND 34343.

unified-diff.test.ts.sourceSummary: Tests createUnifiedDiff for minimal JSON-block insertion diffs, separate contextual hunks for distant changes with context 2, and empty output for identical content.

unified-diff.ts.sourceSummary: Implements createUnifiedDiff that computes LCS-based line diff operations with line-number tracking and emits unified diff headers and contextual hunks with configurable context, handling null existing as /dev/null.

web-breadcrumb.ts.sourceSummary: Renders a file-path breadcrumb WebNode with tree command actions per segment plus open-in-timeline action/button helpers and their CSS.

workspace-root.ts.sourceSummary: Resolves workspace root from core DB and dmBotRoot and validates repository paths for workspace containment, directory existence, and git top-level containment.

summary.value: Shared support layer for file commands providing CLI option normalization, ignore filtering with git integration, workspace root resolution and path validation, Blossom/Nostr file transfer, unified diff generation, and file-path breadcrumb rendering.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Cross-cutting foundation beneath the plugins/file/commands 20-command aggregation — supplies the reusable primitives that let both the validate-containment → execute → adapt file/git family and the inherited-context/hash-cache/plan-draft-accept bottomup family share enforcement and presentation. Decouples workspace containment, ignore/git filtering, CLI coercion, Blossom/NIP-44 transfer, diff generation, and breadcrumb rendering from per-command handlers so adapter.ts/handleFile dispatch and registration stay thin and subcommands remain focused on domain execution.

files.cli-option-parsing.ts: CLI-boundary coercion seam for the 20 subcommands' CLI adapters — normalizes raw flag strings into typed nullable overrides before Zod bottomup contracts and filesystem op validation, enabling consistent option handling across generate/enrich/summarize and file operation commands.
files.ignore-filter.ts: Traversal-guard used by tree/search/generate and bottomup coverage flows to enforce .git/.gitignore/IGNORE/hidden-file policy via ripgrep-compatible globs and cached Bun.spawnSync git check-ignore/ls-files, centralizing filtering so commands share a single containment-aware ignore decision.
files.nostr-file.ts: Secure-transfer primitive for the encrypted file-sharing pair (upload/download) — encapsulates Blossom https://blossom-01.uid.ovh/ auth/upload/download with kind 24242 events and naddr construction for FILE_KIND 34343/NIP-44, isolating Nostr/Blossom/integrity handling from command orchestration.
files.unified-diff.test.ts: Contract test for the shared diff primitive — locks LCS-based hunk/context behavior that bottomup plan/draft renderers and file edit previews rely on for stable modal diff/accept-UI output.
files.unified-diff.ts: Presentation primitive for preview/accept lifecycle — generates LCS-based unified diffs with configurable context for plan/draft/accept modals and file change previews, shared by bottomup and file commands to render workspace changes without per-command diff logic.
files.web-breadcrumb.ts: Shared web rendering primitive for tree/file navigation — builds file-path breadcrumb WebNodes with per-segment tree command actions and open-in-timeline helpers/CSS, reused by file operation web adapters to provide consistent containment-aware navigation.
files.workspace-root.ts: Entry guard for all file/git/bottomup execution — resolves workspace root from core DB/dmBotRoot and enforces workspace containment, directory existence, and git top-level checks before any filesystem/git/Blossom operation, anchoring the shared validate-containment step.
